skirmish.module.clanshare.setting.passwo: Shared secret of your clan. Only players with the same password can read your shares. Never typed in chat.
skirmish.module.clanshare.setting.chat_p: Put before the encrypted line, e.g. ! for global chat. Empty = local chat.
skirmish.module.clanshare.setting.max_ag: Ignore shares older than this (protects against old lines being reposted). 0 = no limit.
skirmish.module.clanshare.setting.select: Clicking a share also selects the waypoint for the HUD arrow.
skirmish.module.clanshare.setting.blocke: Comma separated letter/digit fragments the server's chat filter blocks; the encrypted text is regenerated until it contains none.
skirmish.module.clanshare.setting.finger: Prints a short code in chat. Clan mates with the same password see the same code.
skirmish.clanshare.label: [Clan] %s → %s (%s)
skirmish.clanshare.hover:

skirmish.clanshare.cooldown: Wait %s s before the next share
skirmish.clanshare.no_password: Set the clan password in the Skirmish menu first
skirmish.clanshare.key_pending: Preparing the clan key, the share goes out in a moment
skirmish.clanshare.key_failed: Clan key is not available, see debug.log
skirmish.clanshare.encode_failed: Could not encode the share, see debug.log
skirmish.clanshare.command_usage: Used by ClanShare chat labels; type .share [name] in chat to share your position
